name: Meeting notes
description: Each weekday evening: today's meeting notes summed up, with decisions and who does what next.
instructions_md: Gather today's meeting notes from my notes app if one is connected (Fireflies, Granola or others), otherwise from today's calendar events and anything I sent you. For each meeting, write here: a three-line summary, the decisions, and the action items with owners and dates. Save each meeting's decisions and action items in memory so tomorrow's prep can find them, and ask me before sending anything to anyone.
